name: assign_alias
description:
Creates a new alias for the deployment resolved from the given deployment or alias ID or URL. The authenticated user or team must own this deployment. If the desired alias is already assigned to another deployment, then it will be removed from the old deployment and assigned to the new one.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/deployments/{id}/aliases --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

id.description: The deployment or alias ID or URL to assign from

alias.description: The alias we want to assign to the deployment defined in the URL

anyOf.description: The redirect property will take precedence over the deployment id from the URL and consists of a hostname (like test.com) to which the alias should redirect using status code 307

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
